dataset.availability: all complete bars available at their recorded close
dataset.calendar: weekday-only UTC sessions; no real exchange holiday calendar
dataset.prices: unadjusted synthetic prices; no corporate actions or dividends
dataset.universe: fixed fictional assets; no membership selection or survivorship claim

limitations: Local hashes detect changes relative to a manifest; they are not signatures or independent timestamps.
The operator can inspect the input CSV or create another run. This is an explicit holdout boundary, not a tamper-proof vault.
Candidate count covers this plan only. External and previous manual trials are not discovered automatically.
Timestamp declarations and data provenance are supplied by the importer, not certified by Chronal.
plan.selection_rule: highest development zero-risk-free-rate Sharpe; lexical tie break; undefined ranks last

model.feature_formula: At close k: close[k]/close[k-1]-1; close[k]/close[k-5]-1; close[k]/close[k-L]-1; sample std of L trailing close returns; close[k]/mean(close[k-L:k+1])-1; open[k]/close[k-1]-1. One pooled model across assets; scaler and centered ridge fit on training examples only.
model.interpretation: Regression estimates are uncalibrated research scores, not return guarantees.
